question_text: Explain why depending on a small abstract interface rather than the internal fields of another class can improve maintainability.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Client code uses a stable set of operations. The other class can change its internal representation without forcing changes throughout clients, provided the interface remains consistent. This localizes modifications and reduces error risk.
